name: 99503 · Anchorage, AK
findings: ZIP 99503 (Anchorage) has 270 nonprofit organizations. 141 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 119 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (11% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 99503 (Anchorage) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
